subject: english

knowledge.name: Unit 1 Why do people move to new places?
Moving reasons 搬迁原因词
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 Why do people move to new places?
knowledge.explanation: for a better job、for their children's study、to be near family、because of the weather，这些短语是课文归纳的主要搬迁原因。

knowledge.name: Why did 过去时问答
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 Why do people move to new places?
knowledge.explanation: 描述已发生的搬迁用一般过去时：Why did they move here? They moved here last year. did 后动词用原形。

knowledge.name: because 与 so 连接因果
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 Why do people move to new places?
knowledge.explanation: because 表原因（后接句子），so 表结果；同一句中 because 与 so 不能同时使用。

knowledge.name: move to 与 move in
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 Why do people move to new places?
knowledge.explanation: move to + 城市/国家表示搬到某地；move in 表示搬进某处（move in next week）。不要写成 move in Shenzhen。
prerequisites: because 与 so 连接因果

chapters.name: Unit 1 Why do people move to new places?

questions.analysis: 搬到某地用 move to；move in 表示搬进某处，move 后缺介词，move at 搭配错误。

questions.stem: — Why did they move here? — （  ） they wanted a better job.
questions.analysis: 回答 Why 用 Because 引出原因；So 表结果，But 表转折，Or 表选择。
questions.knowledge_point: because 与 so 连接因果

questions.stem: They （  ） （move） to Shenzhen two years ago.
questions.analysis: two years ago 是过去时间标志，move 用过去式 moved；写 move 则时态不符。

questions.stem: 同一句话里 because 和 so 不能同时使用。
questions.analysis: 汉语说「因为……所以……」，英语只保留一个连词：Because he was ill, he stayed home. 或 He was ill, so he stayed home.，说法正确。
questions.knowledge_point: because 与 so 连接因果

questions.stem: — （  ） did your family move to this city? — For a better job.
questions.analysis: 答语说明原因，所以问句用 Why；When 问时间，Where 问地点，Who 问人。

questions.stem: — Why （  ） he move to Beijing? — Because his father found a job there.
questions.analysis: 一般过去时的特殊疑问句用 did + 主语 + 动词原形，所以填 did；填 does 则时态变成现在时。

questions.stem: 下列属于人们搬家的常见原因的有（  ）
questions.analysis: A 为了更好的工作 ✓；B 为了孩子上学 ✓；C 为了离家人近 ✓；D「为了忘记怎么读书」不合常理 ✗。故 A、B、C 成立，D 不成立。

questions.stem: They moved here last year. 表示他们去年搬到这里，是过去发生的事。
questions.analysis: last year 是过去时间，动词用 moved，句子描述过去发生的事，说法正确。

options: Because it was quiet, they moved to the countryside.
Because it was quiet, so they moved to the countryside.
It was quiet because so they moved.
They moved because so it was quiet.
questions.analysis: A 只用 because，正确；B 同时用 because 和 so 重复；C、D 语序与搭配都错误。
questions.knowledge_point: because 与 so 连接因果

questions.stem: We will （  ） （move） into our new flat next Monday.
questions.analysis: next Monday 表示将来，will 后接动词原形 move；move in 表示搬进，与 into 连用也常见。

questions.stem: 关于一般过去时的特殊疑问句，说法正确的有（  ）
options: did 后面的动词用原形
主语是 he 时用 does
时间状语常用 last year、two years ago
questions.analysis: A 过去时疑问用 did ✓；B did 后动词还原 ✓；C 过去时不论主语人称都用 did，不用 does ✗；D 过去时间状语常见 ✓。故 A、B、D 成立，C 不成立。

questions.stem: move in Shenzhen 是正确的表达。
questions.analysis: 搬到某城市用 move to Shenzhen；move in 后面不接城市，应说 move in（搬进某处）。

questions.stem: — Why do people move to big cities? — （  ） there are more jobs.
questions.analysis: 答语解释原因，用 Because；So 表结果，Although 表让步，If 表条件。
questions.knowledge_point: because 与 so 连接因果

questions.stem: His family （  ） （move） to a small town because the air there is clean.
questions.analysis: 句中说明已发生的搬迁，用过去式 moved；写 moves 则时态为现在时，与语境不符。

questions.stem: so 后面接的是原因，because 后面接的是结果。
questions.analysis: 说反了：because 后面接原因，so 后面接结果，所以原句错误。
questions.knowledge_point: because 与 so 连接因果

questions.stem: 用英语写两句话，说明一个家庭搬家的原因和结果，要求用上 because 或 so。

answer.value: The family moved to Shenzhen because the father found a better job there. So the children went to a new school.

questions.analysis: 参考示例见答案。评分要点：①写出原因（1 分）；②写出结果（1 分）；③because 或 so 使用正确、不同时出现（2 分）；④时态用过去式（1 分）；⑤大小写与标点（1 分）。同句 both because and so 不得分。
questions.knowledge_point: because 与 so 连接因果

questions.stem: 把对话补全并译成中文：A: （  ） did your family move here? B: We moved here （  ） my mother got a new job.

answer.value: Why；because。译文：A：你们家为什么搬到这里？B：我们搬到这里，因为我妈妈找到了新工作。

questions.analysis: 参考答案：第一空 Why（问原因）；第二空 because（引出原因）。译文见答案。评分要点：①两空正确（2 分）；②译文准确（2 分）；③大小写与标点（1 分）。第二空填 so 则因果颠倒。

questions.stem: 「他们三年前搬到了上海」的英文是（  ）
options: They moved to Shanghai three years ago.
They move to Shanghai three years ago.
They moved in Shanghai three years ago.
They are moving to Shanghai three years ago.
questions.analysis: three years ago 要求过去式 moved to，A 正确；B 时态错，C 介词错（应用 to），D 现在进行时与过去时间矛盾。
